categoryNotes.title: Development dependencies
categoryNotes.note: Recreated by your package manager's install or the next build.

categoryNotes.title: Build outputs
categoryNotes.note: Rebuilt from your source on the next build.

categoryNotes.title: Development caches
categoryNotes.note: Package and build caches re-download or rebuild when a tool needs them.

categoryNotes.title: Device support files
categoryNotes.note: Android system images re-download from Android Studio's SDK Manager. An emulator built on one stops working until you do.

categoryNotes.title: System caches
categoryNotes.note: Windows and apps recreate these. Review what you don't recognize.

categoryNotes.title: Diagnostics
categoryNotes.note: Crash dumps and logs. Nothing needs them unless you are debugging a crash.
